technical_and_design_decisions: Modules will be developed as Spring Cloud Stream standalone apps/starters targeting Java 17+ and current Spring Cloud Stream standards.
AWS Kinesis Sink (U1) will leverage Spring Cloud Stream Binder for Kinesis / AWS SDK v2.
Job DSL (U3) will be implemented using a Groovy-based DSL parser and orchestration engine integrated into the Spring XD workflow execution environment.
Analytics sink modules (U4, U5, U6, U7) ported from Spring XD will be refactored to use Spring Cloud Stream programming models and Spring Data / Redis stores where applicable.
Flink Processor (U8) will wrap Apache Flink DataStream API inside a Spring Cloud Stream processor pattern to enable stream processing and ML integration.
assumptions: Legacy Spring XD codebase and module sources are available for reference and porting.
Target runtime environment supports Spring Cloud Stream 4.x / Spring Boot 3.x.
A single full-stack Java/Spring software developer will perform design, implementation, unit/integration testing, and documentation.
One workday represents 8 hours of active development time.

activities.activity_description: Set up project repository structure, build scripts (Gradle/Maven), baseline dependency management for Spring Cloud Stream, and CI pipeline setup.
Develop Spring Cloud Stream Kinesis sink module, configure Kinesis producer integration, handle error queues, and write integration tests.
Port the Log sink module from XD to the s-c-s repository, implement customizable log formatting and levels, and create unit tests.

activities.activity_name: U3: Implement Job DSL Orchestration Option in XD
activities.activity_description: Design and implement Job DSL parser, job execution graph orchestration, error handling, DSL validation, and workflow runtime integration.
Port Field-Value-Counter logic from XD, adapt payload parsing and repository counter storage to s-c-s sink specifications, and add tests.
Port Aggregate-Counter module from XD, adapt time-series aggregation logic, integrate storage backends, and verify with unit/integration tests.
Port Gauge sink module from XD to s-c-s, implementing single-value gauge metrics updates and automated tests.
Port Rich-Gauge sink module from XD to s-c-s, incorporating rich statistical tracking (min, max, average, alpha-smoothing) and test coverage.

activities.activity_name: U8: Implement Apache Flink Processor Module
activities.activity_description: Create Flink processor wrapper for s-c-s, enabling Flink DataStream execution, stream ML abstractions, and pipeline serialization/testing.

activities.activity_name: System Integration, E2E Verification, and Documentation
activities.activity_description: Perform end-to-end integration testing across streaming modules, verify DSL job orchestration, and write developer documentation and usage samples.
